title: Barleycorn's
venue_description:
Wichita's Premier Original Music Venue

Barleycorn's is a nationally revered bar and live music venue located just outside of historic Old Town Wichita. Since its establishment - this intimate venue has become synonymous with original music and authentic performances - earning recognition throughout the region as one of the best places to catch live shows.

The Venue Experience

With a seated capacity of 155 and standing room for 240 - Barleycorn's offers an intimate concert experience where audiences can connect directly with performers. The venue's commitment to showcasing original music sets it apart from typical cover band venues - creating a space where artists can share their authentic creative work.

Weekly Music Programming

The venue hosts live music Thursday through Saturday nights - with shows typically starting at 9pm. Wednesday nights are dedicated to open mic - welcoming all genres and skill levels from solo performers to full bands. Sunday evenings feature acoustic open mic sessions from 7pm-11pm - where musicians - comedians - and spoken word artists can share their talents.

Technical Specifications

Barleycorn's provides professional-grade sound equipment including a Behringer x-18 digital mixer with 18 inputs and 6 monitor mixes - Peavey IPR 300 and PV2600 power amplifiers - Behringer x-Pro crossover - two Peavey SP-2 mains (hung) - three 18-inch subwoofers (one Peavey and two Yorkville) - and five powered monitors. This setup ensures excellent sound quality for both performers and audiences.

Community & Culture

Beyond music - Barleycorn's offers daily drink specials including half-priced drinks on Thursdays. Monday evenings feature trivia nights - creating additional opportunities for community gathering. The venue maintains an all-ages policy for most shows (21+ for alcohol service) and has become a rite of passage for Wichita musicians.

Location & Accessibility

Situated at 608 E Douglas Ave - just outside the historic Old Town entertainment district - Barleycorn's is easily accessible and part of Wichita's vibrant downtown cultural corridor. The venue's reputation extends beyond local borders - attracting regional and national touring acts alongside the best local talent.

title: Fairmount Coffee Co.
venue_description:
Community Coffeehouse & Music Venue

Fairmount Coffee Co. is a locally-owned coffeehouse located just south of Wichita State University on 17th Street. Launched as an outreach of Fairmount Ministries - it serves as a welcoming gathering space for the university community and surrounding neighborhoods.

Coffee & Food

The coffeehouse features locally roasted handcrafted coffee drinks from roasters including Oddly Correct - Messenger Coffee - and Pennant Coffee. The menu includes locally sourced organic teas - fresh baked goods made daily - breakfast items - paninis - wraps - and salads. Everything is prepared with quality local ingredients.

Music & Events

Fairmount Coffee hosts live music and open mic nights on weekends - with open mic nights held on the first Friday of every month. These family-friendly events welcome musicians with instrumental and vocal performances. The venue also features Final Friday shows and other special music events - creating a vibrant cultural space within the community.

Atmosphere & Community

The coffeehouse offers a cozy atmosphere perfect for studying - working - meeting friends - or enjoying live performances. On any given day - you'll find university students - local residents - and community members using the space as a gathering place. The venue emphasizes creating connections and fostering community through quality coffee and shared experiences.

Hours & Services

Open Monday through Friday 7am-7pm and Saturday 8am-5pm. The space is available for small group meetings and events during business hours - and also provides catering services for off-site functions.

title: Kirby's Beer Store
venue_description:
Wichita's Legendary Dive Bar & Music Venue Since 1972

Kirby's Beer Store has been a cornerstone of Wichita's underground music scene for over 50 years. This no-frills dive bar is more than just a place to grab a drink - it's a historic music venue that has shaped the local alternative and independent music community for generations.

Live Music Heritage

With both indoor and outdoor stages - Kirby's hosts unforgettable live performances ranging from intimate indoor gigs to outdoor concerts under the stars. The venue is willing to host live music any night of the week - with Mondays traditionally reserved for open mic and jam sessions. All shows are free and typically start at 10 PM unless otherwise noted.

Signature Events

Kirby's is home to several legendary recurring events. Goth Nite has been running for over 25 years - making it one of the longest-running recurring events in Wichita. DJ Act of Contrition spins darkwave - post-punk - industrial - and shadowy dance cuts in an atmosphere built for those who feel most at home after dark. The annual MeatFest is a three-day music festival celebrating volume - excess - and late nights - featuring rotating lineups of local and regional bands.

Atmosphere & Amenities

Located near Wichita State University campus - Kirby's offers an authentic dive bar experience with incredibly affordable drinks and friendly - personable bartenders. The walls are covered with decades of posters and memorabilia - telling the story of Wichita's underground music history. Next door - Kirby's Flipside provides a retro-inspired pinball arcade with vintage machines.

Community Hub

Kirby's isn't just a bar - it's a welcoming community hub where everyone feels at home. Whether you're a regular or first-timer - you'll find an inclusive environment where creativity - conversation - and camaraderie thrive. The venue has become an essential part of Wichita's cultural fabric - supporting local artists and providing a platform for emerging talent.

Practical Information

Open daily from 3pm-2am. The venue features a cozy patio for outdoor drinking and features super reasonably priced drinks. With its commitment to keeping live music alive and accessible - Kirby's continues to be a vital part of Wichita's music ecosystem.

title: Walker's Jazz Lounge
venue_description:
Wichita's Premier Jazz Club

Walker's Jazz Lounge represents the pinnacle of jazz culture in Wichita - Kansas. Founded by the dynamic father-and-son team of Gary and Walker Jones - this elegant venue is more than just a club - it's a living testament to the enduring legacy of jazz in the community.

The Vision & Mission

At Walker's - the belief in the transformative power of music drives everything. The mission is to create unforgettable experiences through the magic of jazz - celebrating both the rich history and evolving sounds of this iconic genre. From classic standards to contemporary improvisations - every performance ignites the senses and leaves audiences mesmerized.

Live Music Programming

The lounge hosts a variety of live music events Thursday through Saturday - with shows typically running from 5pm to midnight. Tuesday nights are dedicated to jazz performances. The venue showcases both soulful jazz performances from established local legends like Josué - Jim Pisano - and Joel Boettger - as well as rising talent from Wichita State University's acclaimed jazz program and beyond.

Special Events & Series

Walker's features several recurring events including Final Friday Blues presented by the Wichita Blues Society - monthly bluegrass sessions - vinyl listening nights - and jazz ensemble performances. The venue regularly hosts the Wichita Jazz Collective - a talented ensemble of local jazz artists delivering high-energy mixes of classic standards and fresh arrangements.

The Experience

Step into the elegant ambiance and savor handcrafted cocktails - a diverse beer and wine selection - and delectable charcuterie boards and snacks meticulously prepared to enhance your enjoyment. The intimate setting allows for direct connection with performers - creating a musical journey where every note comes alive.

Founders' Legacy

Gary Jones - a long-time Wichita resident and audiophile - served on the Wichita Jazz Festival board for six years and previously operated Living Sound - specializing in high-end audio equipment. His love for music and audio excellence is evident in the venue's top-notch sound quality. Walker Jones - trained as an accountant - brings meticulous attention to detail and event management expertise - ensuring flawless execution of every performance.

Community Connection

As a family-owned establishment - Walker's is rooted in the warm embrace of community. Every event is a reunion of music lovers - a gathering of souls brought together by the timeless allure of jazz. The venue has become a cultural hub where the spirit of jazz thrives and lasting memories are created.

title: Mort's Martini & Cigar Bar
venue_description:
Historic Old Town's Premier Martini Destination

Located in the heart of historic Old Town Wichita - Mort's Martini & Cigar Bar has been a beloved local establishment since 1996. For over 25 years - this sophisticated venue has offered an unparalleled blend of mixology excellence - live music - and relaxation.

The Martini Experience

Mort's is renowned for its extensive martini menu featuring over 160 unique martinis - each meticulously prepared to delight and surprise patrons. The bartenders are true artists - with encyclopedic knowledge of every cocktail on the menu. The venue also maintains a full bar with the finest collection of liquor and an extensive beer selection - ensuring something for every taste.

Live Music Programming

Live music is featured up to 7 nights a week year-round. Tuesday nights are reserved for jazz performances. During spring and summer months - shows take place outside on the heated and cooled patio overlooking 1st Street. Fall and winter performances move inside - featuring solo and duo acoustic acts. The patio is equipped with heaters and fans - making it accessible year-round.

Cigar Selection

For cigar enthusiasts - Mort's offers a quality selection that will please even the most discerning aficionado. The venue has mastered the art of creating a comfortable smoking environment that somehow avoids the typical heavy smoke atmosphere.

Atmosphere & Amenities

The inviting atmosphere is complemented by complimentary jalapeno popcorn - one of the most beloved snacks in Wichita. The venue offers daily drink specials - including half-price martinis on Mondays. With exceptional service and a commitment to making every guest feel like a regular - Mort's has become a staple of Wichita nightlife.

Location & Hours

Situated at 923 E 1st St N in Old Town - the venue is easily accessible and part of Wichita's vibrant entertainment district. Open Monday-Thursday 3pm-1am - Friday-Saturday noon-1am - and Sunday noon-11pm. The venue is 21+ and accepts reservations.

title: Rock Island Live
venue_description:
High-Energy Bar & Concert Venue

Rock Island Live is a lively music venue and bar situated in the heart of Wichita's Old Town entertainment district. Since its establishment - this venue has become recognized for its vibrant atmosphere and diverse live performances - ranging from local bands to touring artists.

Live Music Programming

Shows can be held any night of the week except Friday - which is reserved for DJ performances. The venue hosts nearly nightly performances - establishing itself as a staple in the local music scene. The eclectic programming includes rock - hip-hop - and various other genres - making it a hotspot for music enthusiasts of all tastes.

Venue Features

With its eclectic decor and welcoming ambiance - Rock Island Live offers both indoor seating and a popular outdoor patio area. The spacious dance floor is surrounded by cozy seating - allowing guests to soak in the atmosphere while enjoying drinks from the extensive bar menu. The venue serves a full food menu - including 100% Angus beef burgers and fresh baked breads delivered daily.

Atmosphere

The venue maintains a high-energy environment perfect for groups looking to celebrate special occasions or simply enjoy a night out. With a focus on live entertainment and community - Rock Island Live has become a cultural hub within Old Town.

Hours & Details

Open Tuesday-Sunday 5pm-2am - closed Mondays. Located at 101 N Rock Island St in Old Town Wichita. The venue is 21+ and features both indoor and outdoor spaces for enjoying live music and socializing.
location: 101 N Rock Island St - Wichita - KS 67202

title: The Brickyard
venue_description:
Old Town's Premier Outdoor Music Venue

The Brickyard is Wichita's premier outdoor music venue located in Old Town - adjacent to Public at the Brickyard - a family-owned farm-to-table restaurant. Before becoming one of the city's most popular music destinations - the building had a unique and dynamic history that makes it a cornerstone of Downtown Wichita.

Music Programming

From mid-March through early November - the outdoor stage hosts a rotating mix of local and regional musicians - DJs - EDM shows - and cover bands. Live music is featured Thursday - Friday - and Saturday nights - with Wednesday and Sunday shows throughout the summer season. Saturdays are typically reserved for cover bands and DJs - creating high-energy party atmosphere.

Dinner Music Series

In addition to late-night shows - The Brickyard hosts dinner music Wednesday through Saturday earlier in the evening - featuring acoustic and jazz performances. This creates a more relaxed atmosphere perfect for dining on Public's farm-to-table cuisine while enjoying live music.

Year-Round Events

When the outdoor stage takes its seasonal break (November-March) - The Brickyard continues hosting events on the covered heated patio. These winter events feature softer genres and intimate performances. The venue has hosted special events including the Blues Crawl and various community gatherings.

Venue Features

The venue offers a unique courtyard vibe surrounded by brick walls and open to the air above. A colorful mural adorns the space - creating an Instagram-worthy backdrop. The heated and cooled patio with fireplace allows for comfortable outdoor enjoyment year-round. The venue can be rented for private events and special occasions.

Atmosphere

The vibe is very different during the day (relaxed dining atmosphere) versus night (high-energy party with live music). Most events have a $5 or more cover charge - and the venue is 21+ only starting at 8:30pm. With its commitment to showcasing diverse musical talent and providing a unique outdoor concert experience - The Brickyard has become an essential part of Wichita's music scene.
location: 129 N Rock Island Rd - Wichita - KS 67202
